public_requirements.title: Create, join, & leave workspaces
requirements: An email account can belong to several workspaces, listed together in a workspace switcher.
The switcher permits selecting, creating and joining workspaces. Joining requires an invitation or an enabled eligible domain policy.
Several email accounts can remain signed in simultaneously. The switcher can log out one account while keeping others, or log out all accounts.
Leaving removes workspace access and its switcher entry. Re-entry requires being added again.
The documented paid plan is workspace-scoped. Workspace content is described as separate silos.
public_requirements.documentation_conflict: This page describes the desktop switcher at the bottom of the sidebar. Other help pages retain top-left wording; exact current pixel placement is unverified.

public_requirements.title: Workspaces on mobile
requirements: The mobile Home screen workspace name opens switching, creation, joining and logout actions.
An additional email account can be signed in through the workspace switcher.
Mobile search is described as searching the current workspace.
public_requirements.limitations: Documentation confirms product actions, not implementation framework, native storage, refresh token handling, cache partitioning or runtime parity.

reconstruction_acceptance_implications.requirement: One signed-in identity must list and select all currently authorized workspaces.
reconstruction_acceptance_implications.verification_needed: Actual same-account two-workspace journeys on web, macOS, Windows, iOS and Android.

reconstruction_acceptance_implications.requirement: Workspace selection must change content and permissions while preventing stale responses and offline operations from crossing workspaces.
